name: Form Tips
description: Form Tips module unclutters forms by turning form descriptions into hover-activated tooltips.

suggests.drupal/form_placeholder: When enabled, formtips adds it as a library dependency so descriptions can become placeholders too.

project_description:
Form Tips module uses JavaScript to move form description/help text to tooltips.

 It helps to reduce form clutter by removing form descriptions from the page and only displaying them when needed.

 Back to top 

 Drupal 8 
 The functionality is the same as earlier versions but with a bit easier to modify CSS and the image was replaced with CSS.
